'''Keith Vanderbeck''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 12th, 0 (−86) at [[July 2001 Levittown tournament]] on 7 July 2001, according to Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2596">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-levitown-ny-7-7-01d2596/ levitown-ny-7-7-01], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 8 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-08-levitown-ny-7-7-01d2596/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
